boundaries.name: rust-semantics
boundaries.obligation: The Lean model is handwritten; nothing proves it refines the Rust source, rustc lowering, integer wrapping, or panic behaviour.

boundaries.name: floating-point-arithmetic
boundaries.obligation: All f64 / Complex64 computation (FFT, LDL tree, Gram-Schmidt norms, the Gaussian sampler's exp approximation) is treated as an opaque dependency; no IEEE-754 semantics are modelled.

boundaries.name: bigint-arithmetic
boundaries.obligation: num::BigInt arithmetic, Karatsuba multiplication and the field-norm recursion of ntru_solve are unmodelled imported semantics.

boundaries.name: ntru-equation
boundaries.obligation: That ntru_gen's output satisfies f*G - g*F = q mod (X^N+1), and that FFT(f) is invertible, are assumed properties of the generator, not proved.

boundaries.name: gaussian-sampler-distribution
boundaries.obligation: That ffSampling/samplerz produce the discrete Gaussian required for Falcon's zero-knowledge/security argument is assumed; only integer table facts are proved.
